name: KinToolkit Public Catalog and MCP HTTP API
description: Educational US liquid medicine label lookup, not a personalized prescription. For ordinary product names, map only the public brand, ingredient and bottle audience to find_label_references; never forward the user’s full question or patient details. Ask which bottle or formulation is meant when matches are ambiguous. Store-brand entries are reference-only, not calculator-supported substitutes. Use only an exact listed calculator bottle, concentration and published label band for get_label_directions. Never send names, exact measurements, medical history or other patient details. Do not interpolate, convert concentrations or infer that a label reference is safe for a particular child. Preserve the age restrictions, directions, maximum and source together; verify the full package label and ask a clinician when unsure. This describes the existing discovery catalog and JSON-RPC MCP endpoint, not a REST dosing API. No authentication or API key is required. Tool calls may append minimal operational telemetry; arguments and results are excluded. No persistent protocol session is required. KinToolkit will provide at least 90 days of advance public notice before making breaking changes to or removing supported API or tool functionality. No supported API or tool functionality is currently deprecated. See the [API change policy](https://kintoolkit.com/developers#api-change-policy) for public notices and migration guidance.
